title: Heating Dynamics of a Water Heater with Constant Power and Flow
expert_review: Excellent comparative problem showing how flow affects both equilibrium temperature and transient heating behavior.
source: Control Systems Textbook - Thermal Systems Examples
learning_objectives: Analyze heating dynamics with combined power input and flow
Compute equilibrium temperature under competing effects
Compare transient responses with and without flow
Understand trade-offs between heating power and mass transport
